steps.label: Boot BrowserRT in a cross-origin-isolated browser page
Spawn a module Worker agent and exchange a BRT1 ping
Transfer an ArrayBuffer object ref and observe sender detachment
Touch a bounded control channel without unbounded queue growth
Admit useful work and reject oversized background work without mutation
Write/read a content-addressed OPFS block through the storage-lane adapter
Reload the page and read the block back in the same temporary browser profile
Produce trace, transcript, non-claim, and audit evidence

plan.releasePosture: browser proof is explicit browser/full tier; broad release remains browser-light

successShape.workerAgent: module Worker responds to BRT1 ping and sums transferred Uint32 payload
successShape.transferObjectRef: sender-side ArrayBuffer detaches after transfer to Worker
successShape.boundedChannel: channel send/receive traces prove a tiny control-plane touch
successShape.admissionGovernor: storage write is admitted; an oversized background request is rejected without mutation
successShape.storageLane: OPFS async block store is reached through OpfsBlockStoreStorageLaneAdapter
successShape.reloadReadback: same temporary Chromium profile reload can read/verify/delete the stored block
successShape.transcript: stage transcript makes the proof legible to humans and future sessions
successShape.localReloadHandoff: localStorage handoff lets a human reload and read back the OPFS artifact without CDP-only hidden arguments
successShape.traceExport: trace export receipt gives a compact BrowserRT receipt plus Chrome-trace-shaped envelope for local inspection experiments
successShape.audit: release-tier audit validates contract surfaces without launching Chromium
